text: Webwork sitting 2026-09-23, six decisions taken by question card: (1) the free-tier owner species is an INVENTED spider of ours mapped to the Wyyyschokk under Utinni (Sekkulaath/dianoga shape); (2) one race one kind, no castes; (3) named OLLATHRIX; (4) the silk is named after the spider in the free tier and patches to Shokkweave under Utinni; (5) resident cast besides the spider is very thin, 4-6 rows; (6) nests and egg economy designed this sitting.
